newsitem.title: USA: Westinghouse Air Brake buys 2 airco makers.
newsitem.headline: Westinghouse Air Brake buys 2 airco makers.

text.p: Westinghouse Air Brake Co said Wednesday it bought two air conditioning manufacturers for a total of $7.5 million in cash.

The company said it expected revenues of $30 million from the air conditioning business in the next 18 months, but did not expect a "significant accretive effect from the acquisitions until both units have been fully integrated."
Westinghouse Air Brake said it bought Stone Safety Service Corp of Hackensack, N.J., and Stone UK Ltd of Dartford, Great Bitain, from Itochu Corp's Enprotech Corp.

The company also said it bought the heavy rail air conditioning business of Westinghouse Electric Corp's, Thermo King Corp. The company said it used its revolving line of credit to finance the transactions.

Westinghouse Air Brake reported a $9.6 million net income on revenues of $136.5 million in the first quarter, compared with a net of $7.7 million on revenues of $105.7 million the year before. Its stock traded at 19-7/8 Wednesday at noon, down 1/16.
